name: mdv-second-brain
description: Keeps an Obsidian-compatible second-brain vault per workspace while you work: Kanban board with living task and issue notes, daily session state, distilled project knowledge, strict workspace isolation.

interface.shortDescription: An Obsidian second brain per workspace, kept up to date while you work
interface.longDescription: Keeps an Obsidian-compatible vault for each workspace: a Kanban board whose cards link to living task and issue notes, a daily note with the state of every session, distilled project knowledge, ideas, decisions and post mortems. Inert outside a workspace until you activate it.
